current.text: He comes off the bench. The projected Spurs starters are Fox, Castle, Vassell, Harris and Wembanyama.
The Spurs signed Tobias Harris. The forward and wing group also includes Champagnie and Harrison Barnes.
He is likely about the eighth man in the rotation, still ahead of Harrison Barnes.
This is a contract year for him.
The Spurs roster is very deep at forward. The team is expected to consolidate through trades in the relatively near future, but not right now.
Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD and rank him outside the top 144, so he is not a draft pick in our league.

durable.text: He won the Sixth Man of the Year award.
He is not a starting-caliber player. His numbers as a starter years ago were his ceiling.
He plays very similarly to Saddiq Bey.

note: Keldon Johnson is not a draft pick in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 206 and ESPN 152, and both value him at 0 USD. His projected line of about 13 points on 49% shooting has no weak category, but as roughly the eighth man in a deep Spurs forward group he lacks the minutes, so leave him on waivers and check early in the season whether a Spurs trade or an injury among Harris, Vassell or Champagnie pushes him back to his 23-minute role from last season.
